title: Missiles

# Missiles

# Introduction

Missiles are items that can be shot by the Ballista. Ballistae cannot be armed without missiles.

## List of missiles

• Name: Wooden missile | Damage: Pierce: 75 | Knockback: 45 | ID: TurretBoltWood

• Name: Black metal missile | Damage: Pierce: 120 | Knockback: 60 | ID: TurretBolt

• Name: Flametal missile | Damage: Pierce: 140 | Knockback: 60 | ID: TurretBoltFlametal

Categorias: Missiles, Weapons
